requirement.normalizedRequirement: (ix) Ship structures that are not directly subjected to ice loads may still experience inertial loads of stowed cargo and equipment resulting from ship/ice interaction. These inertial loads, based on accelerations determined by the Classification Society, are to be considered in the design of these structures. The parameters defining the glancing impact load characteristics are reflected in the Class Factors listed in Table 1 and Table 2.
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
